author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Dragon Ball has A LOT of forms - from regular ol' Super Saiyan to Super Saiyan Blue, and off into the heights of Ultra Instinct and Ultra Ego. Many of them have lost their impact over the years and I want to talk about WHY. And most importantly, how several managed to maintain their lustre over the rest.

title: Dragon Ball Ruined EVERY Transformation
